articles.title: The Grand Canyon's Secret Underground Water System
articles.summary: Imagine a hidden world of caves beneath the Grand Canyon, feeding its springs and keeping hikers alive. Scientists just mapped over 10 kilometers of these passages in 3D for the first time. They're racing to understand where the water comes from as the region gets hotter and drier.

articles.title: A Cosmic Mystery Solved: Strange Radio Signals Come from a Star Pair
articles.summary: For years, astronomers were puzzled by weird repeating radio signals from space. Now they've traced one to a white dwarf and a red dwarf locked in a super-fast dance. The pair spins around each other every 1.4 hours, shooting out radio bursts like a lighthouse. This could help decode other mysterious signals.

articles.title: This Fly Ditches Its Wings—and Its Eyesight—After Finding a Home
articles.summary: Imagine a fly that lands on a deer, sheds its wings forever, and then turns down its own vision to save energy. That's the deer ked, and scientists just discovered that after it becomes a permanent blood-feeder, its eye genes drop to half activity. It's a weird trade-off for a life in fur.
